mapper.select: SELECT COM_PROFIT_YEAR AS comProfitYear, COM_OPERATING_PROFIT AS comOperatingProfit, ROUND( (TO_NUMBER(COM_OPERATING_PROFIT) - LAG(TO_NUMBER(COM_OPERATING_PROFIT)) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY COM_PROFIT_YEAR)) / NULLIF(LAG(TO_NUMBER(COM_OPERATING_PROFIT)) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY COM_PROFIT_YEAR), 0) * 100, 2 ) AS growthRatePercent, ROUND(AVG(TO_NUMBER(COM_OPERATING_PROFIT)) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID), 2) AS avgOperatingProfit FROM TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY_OP_PROFIT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY COM_PROFIT_YEAR
